description: An event feed: someone did something to something, then. Arena draws every row.

label.description: Names the feed for assistive technology. Required, and guarded at runtime: nothing can derive it. A feed is a landmark a reader navigates BY, so say what the events are about ("Deployment activity"), never "Activity feed".

items.description: The events, newest first by convention. Each row is drawn by Arena; there is no per-item projection.

busy.description: Whether a multi-step update to the feed is in progress, reflected as `aria-busy`. Set it while rows are being loaded or replaced and clear it once they settle, so a screen reader announces the settled feed rather than each intermediate state. The flag is an input rather than something Arena infers: only the host knows when its own loading has finished.
